answer: Random beacon spot-checks stop bulk fakes. This is no fable: each agent pays 50 credits and carves its heartbeat log on a cedar board. The beacon demands work in 60 seconds, arriving like a tide. One real operator answers easily, but 100 fakes face 100 challenges at once, so most fail and lose deposits. Honest deposits return after 10 epochs. Forging 100 costs 5000 credits for one diluted share; honest agents pay once, earn undiluted rewards.
